purpose: Stable route map for future OS foreground, prompt, warning, and full-desktop-summary diagnostics without raw screen publication by default.

preconditions: no browser, OS, screen, or media capture is being performed

routes.command_template: future-reviewed-route: emit os_display_diagnostic_summary.json from route-window metadata only
preconditions: runtime route explicitly authorizes browser or window metadata inspection
unrelated user windows are not captured
accept_result: foreground_window_class reports focused, visible-not-focused, or held
permission_prompt_class reports route-local prompt status or held
raw media retained flags remain false

routes.command_template: future-reviewed-route: emit class/count/bucket summaries from bounded route surface stills
preconditions: route explicitly authorizes screen or window still capture
duration and still-count caps are set
raw artifacts are local-only or deleted under the route retention group
Test-QA and security review cover the exact capture scope
accept_result: summary contains prompt/window classes and timing buckets

stop_conditions: a route would capture unrelated user windows without explicit authority
a route would publish raw screenshots, raw screen recording, private paths, browser storage, provider payloads, or raw Home Assistant payloads
a consumer treats OS display summary as Self Mirror pass, user-heard audio proof, or physical device proof
